record.finding: Routine factory inspection found 2 production lots with dielectric withstand failures at final inspection.
record.non_conformity: Insulation system did not meet the fictional dielectric withstand criterion for the affected lot.
record.evidence: Factory sample FS-DEMO-002; final-test logs FL-DEMO-002; laboratory report TR-DEMO-002.
record.action_taken: Production hold on affected lots; statutory-style notice issued; corrective action requested.
